meta.name: ab-test-setup
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "conversion experiment," "statistical significance," or "test this." For tracking implementation, see analytics-tracking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并实施A/B测试以优化转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要验证产品改动对用户行为的影响
copy.tagline_en: Plan and implement A/B tests to optimize conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to validate the impact of product changes on user behavior

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计 A/B 测试：从提出假设、计算样本量、选择指标到分析结果，并输出实验简报、检查清单等文档。
howto.when: 当你提到“A/B测试”、“实验”、“转化率”等关键词，或要求设计测试、分析结果时触发。

say.text: 我想测试两个按钮文案，帮我设计一个A/B测试。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写假设、指标和样本量。

say.text: 我的落地页转化率是3%，想提升到4%，该怎么做实验？
say.note: Claude 会建议测试方案并计算所需样本量。

say.text: 帮我分析这个A/B测试的结果是否显著。
say.note: Claude 会检查样本量、p值等并给出结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design A/B tests: from forming hypotheses, calculating sample sizes, selecting metrics, to analyzing results, and outputs experiment briefs, checklists, and other documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "A/B test", "experiment", "conversion rate", or ask to design a test or analyze results.

say_en.text: I want to test two button copy variants. Help me design an A/B test.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through hypothesis, metrics, and sample size.

say_en.text: My landing page conversion rate is 3%. I want to reach 4%. How should I run an experiment?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a test plan and calculate required sample size.

say_en.text: Analyze whether this A/B test result is statistically significant.
say_en.note: Claude will check sample size, p-value, etc., and give a conclusion.
